'1' : '0')` and read back through safeLocalGetRaw (no JSON parse, no kind check), only one caller (line 24017, matching the same key on a subsequent call), so they are unaffected by the new kind check - if _mafftPrefBool had used safeLocalGet with any fallback, the stored '1'/'0' string (typeof 'string') would have been refused and the preference silently reverted to the default.

note: All five safeLocalGet callers (msaviewer_brk_style, searchPresets, clusteringPresets, seqColourPresets, msaviewer_dotPresets) match the kind their writer stores (always a JSON object of preset entries), so no valid stored value is refused. The two raw-string stores (MAFFT_DEF_GA / MAFFT_DEF_ADJUST '1'/'0') and the msaviewer_preset_v44 blob go through safeLocalGetRaw, which bypasses the kind check and is unaffected. No defect found.
